units.source_text: 白黑所花的时间相当悬殊，令人感到名人和七段在心理上和生理上都存在什么差别。

en.t: The amount of time spent by White and Black was so strikingly different that it made one feel there must be some psychological and physiological difference between the Master and the seventh-dan player.

units.source_text: 其实用时推敲本是名人的棋风。

en.t: In fact, taking time to think things through was originally part of the Master's style of play.
